children: The Tasks plugin models work items as type:task Documents with a claim queue and a typed edge graph.

A task is just a Document with type:task in Barkpark's own Postgres — no separate store. That means tasks inherit the whole Content Model: schema validation, Mutation APIs, search, and the Content Graph. The plugin adds task-specific behaviour on top while riding the Plugin Behaviour highway.

: agents call bp task next to atomically claim ready work and bp task close to finish it (CAS on the claim epoch). The whole interface is fronted by the bp CLI as bp task — the legacy bd shim points at the same /v1/tasks endpoints on HTTP API v1, so old commands keep working. The queue also surfaces inside the Go TUI, and task-create authorizes on a plain write token via Auth and Tokens (no membership gate, the flat-mutate exception).

That makes a blocked-task chain traversable with Graph Traversal and visible in a Blast Radius query.
